newsitem.title: JAPAN: Marubeni wins rights for Spire solar panel machine.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni wins rights for Spire solar panel machine.

text.p: Marubeni Corp said on Wednesday it acquired exclusive Asian sales rights and domestic production rights for U.S. Spire Corp's equipment to make solar panels.
The trading house said a small Japanese company had previously imported and sold the equipment in Japan.
Marubeni will also sell the equipment in Taiwan, Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, Korea and the Philippines, it said.
Marubeni, which has the right to produce the photovoltaic manufacturing equipment under licence with Spire, said it had consigned production to Nisshinbo Industries Inc.
Marubeni said it aims to strengthen its sales in the competitive solar energy industry as the Japanese government tries to promote widespread use of "clean" solar energy, Marubeni said.
Marubeni said it expects sales of two billion yen by 2000.
